name: 基本給 (basic salary)
authority: 労働基準法 art.24: wages paid in full, in cash, directly, at least monthly on a fixed day. A part month is paid for the calendar days employed (the work rules' own proration method governs; art.89(ii)). An hourly-paid term (terms.facts.pay_basis HOURLY) is paid its rate for every hour worked on a working day (work.days); a daily-paid term (DAILY) its rate for every day worked (労働基準法 art.24; 最低賃金法施行規則 art.2). A sub-monthly entity (SEMI_MONTHLY, TEN_DAY, WEEKLY) pays the monthly amount spread evenly over the month’s parts (period.parts), each prorated by the part’s own paid days.
